licensing.topic: BC: licence to drive a motor home or tow a house trailer
licensing.value: MVA Regulations s.30.02: Class 7 (and so Class 5) permits '(iii) a motor home or motor home with towed vehicles if the towed vehicles in that combination do not exceed 4 600 kg'. There is no motor-home weight cap in the Class 5/7 text. Class 5 'if permitted on the licence' (the endorsement) permits those combinations without air brakes even if the towed vehicles exceed 4,600 kg. ICBC: a regular licence tows a recreational trailer up to 4,600 kg GVW. Over 4,600 kg needs the House Trailer Endorsement (code 07: knowledge test, learner period, road test, no commercial medical) or the Heavy Trailer Endorsement (code 20: medical exam required; covers any trailer type). Air brakes need an air brake endorsement, or Class 1 when over 4,600 kg.

Training with a registered provider is compulsory for anyone driving a quad, even on a farm, and a helmet is mandatory.
